'''Kijak''' (c. [[3636 BBY]])<ref name="Shrine Restoration Initiative"/> was a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] leader who lived on [[Voss]] after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. He co-founded the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]] after the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] administrator [[Alben-Bal]] approached him asking for help restoring Voss after the conquest.<ref name="Shrine Restoration Initiative"/>
